verdict.rationale: Loops' own docs say it ships official, typed SDKs ('Add Loops to your application in minutes with our SDKs', 'typed SDKs', 'install an official SDK'), and it publishes an OpenAPI spec for client generation. The evidence never names the SDK languages, links SDK reference docs, or shows hands-on use, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages/packages, SDK-specific reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
